copy.headline: Super Bowl 2027 and Jay-Z Halftime Show to Screen in Imax Theaters
copy.caption: Worry not, because Imax is bringing Super Bowl LXI to the big screen. Imax is working with ESPN, the Walt Disney Company and the NFL to screen the Super Bowl in the company’s premium theaters for the first time.
